status: v1 production direction; implementation remains future work
forbidden: generic web-dashboard card grids for every screen
Dota/Valve silhouettes, branded UI or production art copied into the game
uncontrolled neon and persistent full-screen glow
mixed generated art styles without an authored shape/material guide
ornament that competes with combat state
token_philosophy: Neutral dark surfaces carry content; gold marks brand and primary action, branch colors identify affinity and rarity accents frame acquisition value. Never rely on color alone.

display.usage: short title or combat banner; slightly condensed with open counters

heading.usage: panel/card title; at most two lines

label.usage: secondary rarity/level labels, never sole critical instruction

numeric.usage: tabular timer, gold and vital values

typography.font_status: Family/license unresolved. System Arial used only for temporary measurement proof, not selected as shipping brand font.

panels.shape: broad planes with one 8 logical-pixel clipped corner
panels.bevel: one restrained top edge, not layered embossed noise
panels.corner_rule: same cut direction within a screen; title text and tap rectangle remain axis-aligned
panels.shadow: one short soft shadow below raised controls; never text glow

glow.forbidden: persistent bloom around every card, icon and numeral
glow.contrast: critical text sits on opaque surface, not over a glow or illustration

Epic.shape: double upper notch and violet accent
Epic.label: Epic

Legendary.shape: small central crest and gold accent
Legendary.label: Legendary

buttons.primary: solid warm gold, dark label, one bevel; one principal action per view
buttons.secondary: opaque dark surface, clear border and light label
buttons.disabled: reduced accent, explicit unavailable label/reason; readable text remains high contrast
buttons.pressed: 2 logical-pixel inset with no target movement
buttons.focus_selected: bright outline plus check/state text; selected is independent of enabled

hud.layout: central timer above arena; health panels anchor left/right; side tables and long logs move to inspection
hud.safe_area: place interactive HUD inside actual platform insets; background may bleed outward
hud.animation: avoid covering fighter faces, hands and impact space with banners

touch.target_is_layout_not_device_pixel: Use logical size and actual display scaling; physical-device verification required later.
touch.small_icons: Noninteractive branch/rarity icons may be smaller; tap entire card or explicit 44+ inspection target.
touch.gesture: No hover-only information; tap opens full effect/branch names, action confirmation remains clear.

motion.rule: Short purposeful anticipation and settle. Results follow resolver time; motion duration is presentation only.
motion.reduced_motion: Remove shakes, flashes and travel; preserve clear state changes and readable outcome.
motion.effects: No strobing; prefer one impact flash, restrained particles, explicit stop lifetime.

contrast_policy: Project gate: primary/secondary text >=4.5:1 against their assigned opaque surface. Accent-only graphics may be lower but cannot carry sole semantic meaning.
unresolved: Measured device scale, physical safe areas and accessibility options
Final arena/fighter material budgets after profiling
